title: Nonzero binary dot product probability
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $\\gamma\\in\\mathbb{F}_2^n$, where $\\mathbb{F}_2$ is the field with two elements. The uniform probability that the dot product over $\\mathbb{F}_2$ of $\\gamma$ with a uniformly chosen $x\\in\\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is nonzero is $0$ if $\\gamma=0$ and $1/2$ otherwise.
